title: Who Owns Commodore? The Retro PC Brand Still Exists, But A Lot Has Changed - BGR
summary: South Dakota was Gateway's main Amiga branch, but was merged back into the company. In 2007, the company was sued over unpaid royalties by the Cloanto owned Amiga Corporation.
